content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I would like to know if the newest version of [product_name] software can run on a 2010 MacBook Pro. If that's not possible, which versions are compatible? Regards, [user_name].
Hi, Maybe this will help: Which operating systems does [product_name] support? Best regards, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The main question is about whether the latest version of [product_name] software is compatible with a 2010 MacBook Pro. Users are seeking clarification about MacOS support for this software from [company_name]. The discussion emphasizes the need for clear information about which operating systems are supported, so users can confidently install the software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for clear details about whether the latest or any version of [product_name] software works on MacOS for their particular MacBook Pro model.
